remarks: Opportunity knocks at 60 Lawn Avenue, Unit 21. This tri-level townhouse is ready for a full renovation and offers the perfect chance to create a custom space.  The main level features an open layout with space for a living room, dining area, and kitchen, along with a half bath and access to a private balcony. Upstairs are two generous bedrooms and a full bathroom. The lower level includes a den or flexible living space, laundry area, direct access to the garage, and walk-out to a full-size patio.  Whether you're an investor, or buyer with vision, this is your chance to design something fresh in a well-located community that offers an in-ground pool and is close to shopping, restaurants, and public transit. Subject to probate approval. Highest and Best Offers are due Sunday at 2pm
